summary.subject: Cmd: a command is a value, Cmd.new or a literal with the prelude's defaults, and Cmd.run, read, readBytes, capture and start run it, replacing Os.run, output, exec and start; Cmd.pipe joins commands with OS pipes, its status the rightmost failure but a stage before the last that SIGPIPE ended, Cmd.Output.statuses each stage's, Cmd.read naming the failed stage, Cmd.start one process group, a failed start killing the started stages with their group, the last stage deciding a held Ctrl-C; Cmd.string quotes as sh needs and leaves out env and dir; Cmd.wait, kill, stop, pid take a Cmd.Process; Os keeps openPipe and which; removing Os removes Cmd; the prelude parses with field defaults the library fills natively; the signal relay waits out a keyboard signal that reaches it late, which made TestSignals flaky on loaded CI; tests and fuzzers move to Cmd
